title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 306 Pickens Street in Marion, Alabama, as the "Albert Turner, Sr. Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 306 Pickens Street in Marion, Alabama, as the Albert Turner, Sr. Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames the Marion, Alabama, Postal Service building at 306 Pickens Street after Albert Turner, Sr.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 306 Pickens Street in Marion, Alabama, the Albert Turner, Sr. Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the designation took effect on that date.
